cpu-default.basis: dtype_input rounds BF16 only. TQ is absent from q8::has_dot and uses F32 products. Q6_K head is present in q8::has_dot and takes block-int16 under effective F16. PRECISION models the F16-class input with literal F16, not a copy of the candidate integer quantizer.

mi50-default.basis: TQ WeightKernels selects lookup_integer_dot row/tile paths; Q6_K head also uses block-int16. F16-class independent reference follows the same predeclared PRECISION rule.

embedding: Q4_K lookup decodes weights to F32; no matrix-input rounding hook applies.
head_extent: The generic depth probes use prefill then single steps, not every_logits. passes.hpp assigns head extent 1 in that path.
